in_urdu.name: Muiddah
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Guide, Helper
in_urdu.long_meaning: Muiddah ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'udda, meaning to guide or help. In Islamic tradition, Muiddah refers to a guide or helper in spiritual matters, often a teacher or mentor.

in_hindi.name: Muiddah
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Guide, Helper
in_hindi.long_meaning: Muiddah एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Arabic root 'udda, meaning to guide or help. In Islamic tradition, Muiddah refers to a guide or helper in spiritual matters, often a teacher or mentor.
